item.title: How women in the built environment are finding their way back to work
item.description: The UK’s built environment is in a period of reinvention. Project pipelines are evolving, new technologies are reshaping design, and conversations around inclusion are growing louder. Yet for many women hoping to return to the industry, the path remains uneven, writes Mya Driver at UKREiiF. The post How women in the built environment are finding their way back to work appeared first on Place North West.

item.title: MIPIM | Building the North: Unlocking the power of partnership
item.description: As the North of England delegation gathers at MIPIM, it’s great to see how much optimism and ambition is in the air, writes Sam Heyes of Mountain Earth. The real challenge facing the North is how we bridge the gap between ambitious plans and the reality of the build.
